welcome.title: Welcome to omnideck
welcome.detail: A one-time setup will prepare everything omnideck needs on this computer.

preparing.title: Preparing your environment
preparing.detail: Setting omnideck up on this computer. This usually takes a few minutes.

permission.title: Waiting for your permission
permission.detail: Your computer will ask you to approve installing Podman — the software omnideck uses to run in an isolated space. omnideck never sees or stores your password.

permissionMacos.title: Waiting for your permission
permissionMacos.detail: Your Mac will ask you to approve installing Podman. omnideck never sees or stores your password.

permissionWindows.title: Waiting for your permission
permissionWindows.detail: Your computer will ask you to approve turning on Windows Subsystem for Linux, which omnideck needs to run in an isolated space. omnideck never sees or stores your password.

updating.title: Preparing your environment
updating.detail: Bringing omnideck up to date. This usually takes a few minutes.

resuming.title: Preparing your environment
resuming.detail: Continuing from where the last attempt stopped. Anything already finished is kept.

ready.title: omnideck is ready
ready.detail: Everything is prepared. Open omnideck whenever you’re ready.

setupPhases.label: Secure space
setupPhases.activity: Preparing a secure space to run in…

support.title: This computer isn’t supported yet
support.detail: This version of omnideck can’t prepare the required environment on this computer.

components.title: Required software couldn’t be installed
components.detail: This can happen when an earlier attempt was interrupted. Trying again usually clears it.

permission.title: omnideck needs your permission
permission.detail: Permission wasn’t granted. Try again and approve the request from your computer.

windowsPermissionCancelled.title: Windows approval wasn’t granted
windowsPermissionCancelled.detail: The Windows security prompt was cancelled. Try again and choose Yes to continue setup.

macosPermissionCancelled.title: macOS approval wasn’t granted
macosPermissionCancelled.detail: The macOS password prompt was cancelled. Try again and approve it to continue setup.

windowsFeatures.title: Windows features couldn’t be enabled
windowsFeatures.detail: Approval was granted, but Windows couldn’t finish enabling WSL. Install pending Windows updates, restart the computer, then try again.

packageIndex.title: Available software couldn’t be checked
packageIndex.detail: Check your package manager and internet connection, then try again.

windowsInstaller.title: Podman couldn’t be installed
windowsInstaller.detail: Restart Windows and try again. Technical details include the installer’s result.

macosInstaller.title: Podman couldn’t be installed
macosInstaller.detail: Try again and approve the macOS prompt. Technical details include the installer’s result.

linuxInstaller.title: Podman couldn’t be installed
linuxInstaller.detail: Check your package manager and available disk space, then try again.

downloads.title: The download didn’t finish
downloads.detail: Check your internet connection and try again. Anything already downloaded is kept.

podmanDownload.title: Podman’s download didn’t finish
podmanDownload.detail: Check your internet connection and try again. Anything already downloaded will be reused.

environment.title: The secure workspace isn’t responding
environment.detail: It was set up but will not answer. Trying again will attempt to repair it.

release.title: Download omnideck again
release.detail: This installer is incomplete or damaged. Download a fresh copy before trying again.

startup.title: omnideck didn’t finish starting
startup.detail: Everything installed, but omnideck did not answer in time. Trying again runs the startup checks.

restart.title: Restart needed
restart.detail: Windows must restart to finish enabling required features. Save any open work, then restart now or later. If you restart now, omnideck reopens after you sign in and continues setup.

unknown.title: Setup didn’t finish
unknown.detail: Something stopped setup before it completed. Try again, or expand Technical details if it keeps happening.
